$comment: Shared CPF checksum cases. Read by three test suites, one per implementation:
packages/database  — is_valid_cpf(text), used by the count and the list filter
apps/api           — isValidCpfDigits, the authority on submit
apps/mobile        — the Dart twin, so a rep is told as they type
Left to themselves each suite would test whatever its author thought of, and a
fix applied to one implementation would pass everywhere while the others stay
wrong. Add a case here and all three must account for it.
`digits` is what the API and Dart validators receive (already stripped).
`raw` is what the SQL function receives, which strips punctuation itself.

cases.why: same number unpunctuated — formatting must not change the verdict
surrounding whitespace, as pasted from a document
second valid number, so a test cannot pass by hardcoding the first
last check digit off by one
first check digit wrong, second right — catches an implementation that only checks the last digit
all same digit: satisfies the arithmetic but is not a real CPF, and is what gets typed to get past a required field
all zeros — the same trap, and the one a blank form most easily produces
a CNPJ: right shape for the other document type, never a CPF
empty — the blank-string case the warning counts as missing, never as valid
whitespace only, which trims to nothing
letters strip to nothing rather than throwing
a stray letter mid-number leaves ten digits
